items.title: 停止编码的那天，就是失去架构判断力的开始：一位 30 年架构师的 AI 生存指南
items.raw_excerpt: 在 AI Coding 飞速发展的当下，工程师的价值正从“如何实现”转向“解决什么问题”，那么，手敲代码还有意义吗？作为一名坚持编码近 30 年的架构师，微软最有价值专家 (MVP)、开源项目创作者、现任 Aviva Solutions 的代码架构师 Dennis Doomen 的观点直截了当：如果你不深入代码，就无法做出优秀的架构决策。

title_i18n.zh: 停止编码的那天，就是失去架构判断力的开始：一位 30 年架构师的 AI 生存指南
title_i18n.en: The day you stop coding is the day you begin to lose architectural judgment: an AI survival guide from a 30-year architect.
title_i18n.es: El día que dejes de programar, empezarás a perder la capacidad de juicio arquitectónico: guía de supervivencia en la era de la IA de un arquitecto con 30 años de experiencia.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在 AI Coding 飞速发展的当下，工程师的价值正从“如何实现”转向“解决什么问题”，那么，手敲代码还有意义吗？作为一名坚持编码近 30 年的架构师，微软最有价值专家 (MVP)、开源项目创作者、现任 Aviva Solutions 的代码架构师 Dennis Doomen 的观点直截了当：如果你不深入代码，就无法做出优秀的架构决策。
excerpt_i18n.en: In the era of rapidly advancing AI coding, the value of engineers is shifting from "how to implement" to "what problems to solve." So, does hand-coding still matter? As an architect with nearly 30 years of coding experience, Microsoft Most Valuable Professional (MVP), open-source project creator, and current code architect at Aviva Solutions, Dennis Doomen's view is straightforward: if you don't dive deep into the code, you cannot make excellent architectural decisions.
excerpt_i18n.es: En la era del rápido desarrollo de la codificación con IA, el valor de los ingenieros está pasando de "cómo implementar" a "qué problema resolver". Entonces, ¿tiene sentido seguir escribiendo código a mano? Como arquitecto con casi 30 años de experiencia en programación, Microsoft Most Valuable Professional (MVP), creador de proyectos de código abierto y actual arquitecto de software en Aviva Solutions, Dennis Doomen tiene una opinión clara: si no profundizas en el código, no podrás tomar buenas decisiones arquitectónicas.

items.title: Chrome 开了一个危险的头：偷偷给数亿电脑塞 4GB Gemini 模型，占硬盘、耗算力、删了自动重下
items.raw_excerpt: 更值得玩味的是，Chrome 148 版本刚刚悄悄移除了此前版本中“设备端 AI 不会将你的数据发送到 Google 服务器”的声明。连这句承诺都没了，数据去向可想而知。

title_i18n.zh: Chrome 开了一个危险的头：偷偷给数亿电脑塞 4GB Gemini 模型，占硬盘、耗算力、删了自动重下
title_i18n.en: Chrome has set a dangerous precedent: secretly stuffing a 4GB Gemini model into hundreds of millions of computers, taking up hard drive space, consuming computing power, and automatically redownloading if deleted.
title_i18n.es: Chrome ha iniciado una tendencia peligrosa: instalar en secreto el modelo Gemini de 4GB en cientos de millones de ordenadores, ocupando espacio en el disco, consumiendo capacidad de cálculo y, si se elimina, se descarga automáticamente de nuevo.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 更值得玩味的是，Chrome 148 版本刚刚悄悄移除了此前版本中“设备端 AI 不会将你的数据发送到 Google 服务器”的声明。连这句承诺都没了，数据去向可想而知。
excerpt_i18n.en: More intriguingly, Chrome version 148 quietly removed the previous statement that "on-device AI will not send your data to Google servers." With even that promise gone, the destination of the data is obvious.
excerpt_i18n.es: Aún más interesante es que la versión 148 de Chrome acaba de eliminar silenciosamente la declaración de versiones anteriores que decía: "La IA en el dispositivo no enviará tus datos a los servidores de Google". Sin esa promesa, el destino de los datos es evidente.

items.title: AI-native tech assessments (end of LeetCode)
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN! We built openround.ai - an assessment platform to hire AI native engineers. On OpenRound, engineers build a project or solve a problem using AI. This replaces a usual coding round/take home assessment. I believe coding assessments measure who is good at passing interviews, not who is actually a good engineer. We want to flip that by showing how engineers actually work on a real problem. 2 interesting things we solve - 1. Designing assessments and environments that are not one shotted by AI. 2. Differentiating bw a software engineer who uses AI well and a pure vibecoder. Would love for you folks to try it and hear any feedback that you have. Also here to answer any questions about problems, evaluations, market insights, etc.

items.title: Overcoming reward signal challenges: Verifiable rewards-based reinforcement learning with GRPO on SageMaker AI
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, you will learn how to implement reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to introduce verification and transparency into reward signals to improve training performance. This approach works best when outputs can be objectively verified for correctness, such as in mathematical reasoning, code generation, or symbolic manipulation tasks. You will also learn how to layer techniques like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and few-shot examples to further improve results. You’ll use the GSM8K dataset (Grade School Math 8K: a collection of grade school math problems) to improve math problem solving accuracy, but the techniques used here can be adapted to a wide variety of other use cases.

items.title: RVPO: Risk-Sensitive Alignment via Variance Regularization
items.raw_excerpt: Current critic-less RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards via an arithmetic mean, leaving them vulnerable to constraint neglect: high-magnitude success in one objective can numerically offset critical failures in others (e.g., safety or formatting), masking low-performing “bottleneck” rewards vital for reliable multi-objective alignment. We propose Reward-Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance during advantage aggregation, shifting the objective from “maximize sum” to “maximize consistency.” We show via Taylor expansion…

title_i18n.en: RVPO: Risk-Sensitive Alignment via Variance Regularization
title_i18n.zh: RVPO：通过方差正则化实现风险敏感对齐
title_i18n.es: RVPO: Alineación sensible al riesgo mediante regularización de la varianza

excerpt_i18n.en: Current critic-less RLHF methods aggregate multi-objective rewards via an arithmetic mean, leaving them vulnerable to constraint neglect: high-magnitude success in one objective can numerically offset critical failures in others (e.g., safety or formatting), masking low-performing “bottleneck” rewards vital for reliable multi-objective alignment. We propose Reward-Variance Policy Optimization (RVPO), a risk-sensitive framework that penalizes inter-reward variance during advantage aggregation, shifting the objective from “maximize sum” to “maximize consistency.” We show via Taylor expansion…
excerpt_i18n.zh: 当前无评论员的RLHF方法通过算术平均聚合多目标奖励，导致其易受约束忽视问题影响：某一目标的高幅度成功在数值上可能抵消关键失败。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los métodos actuales de RLHF sin crítico agregan recompensas multiobjetivo mediante una media aritmética, lo que los hace vulnerables a la negligencia de restricciones: un éxito de gran magnitud en un objetivo puede compensar numéricamente fallos críticos en otro.
